load_geo_data_chease: load geometry data from a CHEASE file into a dictionary of numpy arrays
load_geo_data_eqdsk: load geometry data from an EQDSK file with COCOS convention conversion to cocos=11
load_geo_data_fbt: load geometry data from an MEQ FBT mat file extracting nested structured arrays
get_geometry_dir: get the default geometry directory path when no custom directory is provided
GeometrySource_enum: use the GeometrySource enum to specify CHEASE, FBT, or EQDSK geometry file format
